note: Measured on 2026-09-11 with gameplay export v6 (v6-snapshot-20260911) against tests/fixtures/slippi/parity/fox-fd-4.slp (14_56_00 [C2] Fox + Fox (FD).slp, erickfm/slippi-public-dataset-v3.7 batch_00, ports P2/P4), a second real recording alongside fox-fd.slp, kept in its own baseline file per this loop's instructions until the recordings-list ratchet lands on main (docs/parity.md). Fixed in this batch: game::simulation::advance's pre-"GO" input lock (docs/input-lock.md) neutralized both dispatch input and fighter.previous_input for the locked frames; P4 in this recording holds the control stick down continuously from before the lock through the unlock frame (-39), so the neutralized previous_input made that continuously-held input look like a fresh press exactly at unlock, wrongly edge-triggering fast-fall (game::simulation's fast_fall_threshold check) one frame after the recording shows ordinary gravity. Fixed by keeping previous_input tracking the real, un-neutralized samples throughout the lock (only dispatch sees the neutral controller); this resolves docs/input-lock.md's own "open question" the other way from its original guess. Moved checked_frames from 84 to 85 (first_divergent_frame from -39 to -38). The new divergence at -38 is P2's action_state (expected 0x0155/341 = Action::SpecialN, actual 0x002a/42 = Action::Landing): the recording shows P2 pressing B out of Landing once its interrupt window opens and entering Fox's neutral special (Blaster), which game::specials::grounded_chain_open does not currently list Action::Landing among its eligible ground chains (only Wait/Walk/Dash/Run/RunBrake/Turn/Squat family, or tilt::interrupt_chain's Wait/Taunt result, which does check landing::interruptible internally but is evidently not satisfied here), so Skirmish's fighter stays in Landing instead. This is an unmodeled-system stop condition explicitly called out by this loop's own instructions (Fox's Blaster/neutral special), and a live concurrent worktree (skirmish-blaster) is already reserved for exactly this area, so it is reported here rather than fixed, to avoid duplicating that batch's work.
